newsitem.title: USA: Alkermes files to offer 2 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Alkermes files to offer 2 mln common shares.

text.p: Alkermes Inc filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to 2.0 million common shares.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Robertson, Stephens & Co and Montgomery Securities.

The company, which applies biotechnology tools to the development of proprietary drug delivery systems, said it plans to use the proceeds for preclinical testing and clinical trials and other research and development activities.
Alkermes said proceeds will also go toward commercial manufacturing facilities and equipment, working capital and other general corporate purposes.
